author: justtoby
quote: I believe Rockstar is being DEEPLY disrespectful to not only their fans, but themselves. Took 13 years just to cost $100 to play do chores for your girlfriend simulator. Nothing compared to GTA 5. The graphics are good, although there is a lack of optimization and visual and physics bugs everywhere. The game is obviously more advanced than GTA 5, but the GTA 5 story actually was enjoyable, had actual funny moments, and more. What do you mean I have to do chores for like a quarter of the whole story?!
